description: Ministry of Agriculture - Regulations made under the Control of Pesticides Act, control of Pesticides Regulations (Time Limits) of 01 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Agriculture under the Control of Pesticides Act, establishing time limits and maximum residue levels for pesticides on various food crops.
